Control Vulnerability Description: After the move to distroless Debian 12 (0.4.4: 258 findings down to 59), the runtime image still carries unfixed findings in libraries the binary needs: libxml2 (1 Critical, 7 High; SAML), zlib1g (1 Critical, CVE-2023-45853), libssl3 (1 High), and Medium/Low in glibc, libxslt and the GCC runtime. None has a fix in Debian 12 at scan time.
Milestone with Completion Dates: Next release: Rebuild on each Debian security update and at every release (the release scan shows what is fixed); track libxml2 and zlib fixes; consider building libxml2/xmlsec from current upstream releases if Debian doesn't fix them. [[DATE]]
Recommendations: Rebuild on each Debian security update and at every release (the release scan shows what is fixed); track libxml2 and zlib fixes; consider building libxml2/xmlsec from current upstream releases if Debian doesn't fix them.
